（用於南亞食物烹調的）酥油，印度奶油，精鍊奶油
› an occasion when people show that they disagree with something by standing around a person in authority and not letting them leave until they agree to do what the people want
（人們圍著官方人士不讓離開的）對峙場景
› mainly UK US usually pickle a small type of cucumber (= a long, thin, green vegetable) that is often pickled (= preserved in vinegar)
› an area of a city, especially a very poor area, where people of a particular race or religion live closely together and apart from other people
（尤指城市中貧窮的）某種族（或宗教信仰者）聚居區；貧民區
› in the past, an area of a city where Jews were made to live
› a part of society or group that is in some way divided from the main part
（階層、團體或集團等的）聚居區

example: As a child she lived in one of New York's poorest ghettos.
童年時，她居住的地方是紐約最貧窮的貧民區之一。
Brought up in what he describes as "a middle class ghetto", he imagined that all people were as privileged as he was.
自稱從小在「一個中產階級聚居區」長大的他，以為所有人都享有跟他一樣的待遇。

› to treat a particular group in society as if they are different from the other parts of society and as if their activities and interests are not important to other people
使集中居住（彷彿他們不同於其他社會群體或彷彿他們的行為和興趣比其他人劣等）

example: Feminist writers, she claimed, had been ghettoized, their books placed on separate shelves in the shops.
她聲稱女權主義作家被區別對待了，她們的作品都放在書店中單獨的書架上。
The TV company is aware of the danger of ghettoizing disability issues by offering "specialist" programmes.
電視臺意識到，為殘疾人士提供「專家節目」有把殘疾人士問題隔離起來的危險。
